notes: Single style transcribed from the Republic page itself (not imported from any Rheem-family file). Page anchors week/year to the digits following the factory (middle) letter, typically F, M, G, W or N; the schema uses absolute positions, so the pattern fixes the factory letter at index 7 as in the page example and the week/year are the first four digits after it. No month rule is stated in the page text (the legend's month colour has no accompanying month rule), so no month is encoded.

styles.era: Factory-letter serials, 7 characters, factory letter, then digits
styles.notes: Page states week is the 1st and 2nd numbers following the middle letter and year is the 3rd and 4th numbers following it; in the example the middle letter F sits at index 7, so week is positions [8,10] and year [10,12].
